scope: Independent read-only production source review plus seven authored tests using self-authored PCM WAV and a source-proven shared-file archive control. No proprietary target execution or native audio-conformance observation.

resolved_findings.issue: Attaching to one event could accept an association shared by another event with an inadmissible segment, causing later save/load failure.
resolved_findings.correction: ProjectStore now validates every linked event through validateCPRAudioMedia(result, at: root) before accepted=true.
resolved_findings.verification: A structurally generated two-event CPR declares one shared AudioFile and separate segments. Normal import creates its genuine source SHA/report. The first segment fits1058400 frames and the second exceeds it by1; attachment to the first rejects with sourceRangeExceeded, removes the copy and leaves the manifest unchanged. The matched valid control shares one attachment, persists, and retains the association when only one event is deleted.

resolved_findings.issue: The failure cleanup defer was installed after copyItem, leaving a possible partial destination outside cleanup if the copy itself failed.
resolved_findings.correction: The cleanup defer is now installed before copyItem.
resolved_findings.verification: Read-only source inspection confirms ordering. The post-copy shared-source rejection exercises the same cleanup. No deterministic low-level mid-copy I/O failure was injected.

initial_attempt.outcome: Swift Testing macro rejected a throwing right-hand conjunction in the new test source. Split into independent assertions; production code unchanged.
